name: flow_evolution_showcase
description: Inspectable, approval-gated Flow evolution demo. It reads a target Blueprint, proposes the smallest structural change, applies it transactionally and verifies the new revision.

architect.description: Flow architect allowed to inspect and patch Harness Blueprints

inspect.instructions:
Read the target_harness name explicitly stated in this request and call manage_harness(action='inspect', harness_name=...) exactly once. Do not mutate anything. Then report the returned revision and compact Blueprint verbatim enough for another model to author patch operations.

${ctx.request}

approve.name: Flow structure mutation
approve.prompt_text:
模型提出了下面这次 Flow 结构变更。批准后才会原子写入；拒绝则不会改文件。
${ctx.mutation_plan}

apply.instructions:
Apply exactly this approved plan using one manage_harness(action='patch') call. Copy target_harness, expected_revision, operations and reason exactly; set dry_run=false. Do not redesign it and do not perform any second mutation. Then report ok, transaction_id, revision and diff.

${ctx.mutation_plan}

verify.instructions: Verify the approved target with exactly one fresh manage_harness(action='inspect') call. Confirm whether the proposed steps and edges exist and record the new revision. Do not mutate. Target and proposal: ${ctx.mutation_plan}

invalid.value: 没有生成可验证的最小 Flow 变更；未写入任何文件。

rejected.value: 用户拒绝了 Flow 结构变更；未写入任何文件。
